title: Hearty Herbal Polish Chicken Skillet
description: A mustardy and springy post-workout Polish dish featuring garlic powder and flambe, this recipe is perfect for a gluten-free friendly meal. It combines the flavors of chicken, herbs, and spices in a delicious skillet
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic powder, thyme, parsley, mustard, chicken broth, salt, and pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Use a match or lighter to flambe the skillet, being careful not to burn yourself.
Let the skillet cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the chicken and sauce over rice or noodles.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
